summary: Learn content governance, rights management and brand safety with practical templates, workflows and dashboards. Enquire now for a 5-day course.
lede: Content governance and compliance training helps content, campaign and brand professionals control how material is created, approved and published. It covers mapping decision rights and approval workflows, tracking copyright, licensing and asset permissions, assessing brand-safety risks, and reviewing AI-assisted content; practical exercises include creating a rights register, policy, checklist and governance dashboard. Participants also learn to monitor controls and escalate issues involving third-party content.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with content, campaigns, brand assets or review processes and need stronger control over publishing risk. It is especially relevant when you are responsible for content decisions, asset permissions, brand integrity or compliance oversight across multiple channels.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and be prepared to work with sample content inventories, brand guidelines, approval forms and rights records. Familiarity with content management systems, digital asset management platforms or editorial calendars will help, and it is useful to have examples from your own workplace for the exercises. No programming language, specialised software license or advanced technical setup is required, although access to spreadsheet software is recommended for the dashboard and register exercises.
